## Presentation Title
**Data Science Fundamentals**
*Statistics, probability, models, and metrics — visualized with cinematic clarity*

## Style Direction
- Cinematic premium education deck: Apple keynote precision × MIT lecture elegance × Bloomberg data-design polish
- Editorial magazine pacing: spacious layouts, dramatic section openers, refined mathematical storytelling
- Feel like a high-end documentary about how data becomes decisions: intelligent, visual, confident, immersive
- Use mathematical diagrams, probability visuals, regression/classification examples, metric dashboards, and annotated model outputs
- Avoid generic PowerPoint templates, clip-art icons, crowded formulas, default charts, and textbook-heavy slides

## Core Artistic Direction
- Photography style: abstract macro imagery of data centers, glass boards with equations, analysts at dark workstations, and luminous data projections
- Typography approach: bold cinematic serif or grotesk headlines, crisp mono labels for formulas/code, refined sans-serif body text with generous spacing
- Diagram language: glowing coordinate grids, probability distributions, hypothesis-testing curves, regression lines, decision boundaries, confusion matrices
- Texture/effects: subtle film grain, translucent glass panels, blueprint overlays, soft shadows, thin luminous strokes, mathematical annotation layers
- Layout mood: editorial asymmetry, full-bleed hero visuals, floating formula cards, split-screen examples, premium dashboard compositions
- Color philosophy: deep navy, graphite black, soft ivory, electric cyan, statistical violet, signal green, alert amber for metric emphasis
- Animation energy: smooth graph-drawing reveals, probability curves sweeping in, decision boundaries morphing, KPI cards counting up, formula terms highlighting sequentially
- Overall finish: cinematic, precise, premium, and instructional — every slide should feel like a museum-quality explainer for modern data science

## Color Palette

**Midnight Kernel** `#0B1020` — deep cinematic background for hero slides and math-heavy sections.  
**Graphite Ink** `#1E293B` — primary text, axes, labels, and editorial UI lines.  
**Data Blue** `#2563EB` — core accent for statistics, regression lines, and key formulas.  
**Probability Cyan** `#06B6D4` — probability trees, distributions, sampling visuals, and highlights.  
**Inference Violet** `#7C3AED` — hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, and decision regions.  
**Model Green** `#22C55E` — classification boundaries, correct predictions, success states.  
**Error Amber** `#F59E0B` — residuals, uncertainty bands, warnings, false positives/negatives.  
**Signal Red** `#EF4444` — critical errors, rejected hypotheses, misclassification zones.  
**Paper White** `#F8FAFC` — clean editorial slide surfaces, cards, tables, formula panels.  
**Soft Grid Gray** `#CBD5E1` — subtle grids, chart scaffolds, dividers, annotation rules.  

## Typography

**Hero Display: Canela / Playfair Display** — 64–96px, 500–700, cinematic slide titles and major section openers.  
**Editorial Headline: Neue Haas Grotesk Display / Inter Tight** — 36–56px, 600–700, slide headlines and concept statements.  
**Body: Inter / IBM Plex Sans** — 18–26px, 400–500, explanations, examples, and narrative text.  
**Mathematical: STIX Two Math / Latin Modern Math** — 24–44px, regular, equations, formulas, statistical notation.  
**Data Caption: IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono** — 11–16px, 400–600, chart labels, axis notes, metric tags, code-style annotations.  

| Hierarchy | Size | Weight | Usage |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Hero | 72–96px | 600–700 | Opening title, section dividers, cinematic key ideas |
| Section | 44–60px | 600 | Statistics, Probability, Testing, Regression, Classification, Metrics |
| Body | 18–26px | 400–500 | Definitions, examples, concise explanations |
| Caption | 11–16px | 400–600 | Diagram labels, chart notes, formulas, source-style annotations |

## Layout System
- 12-column premium editorial grid; 80px outer margins, 32px gutters, strict baseline alignment for equations, charts, and callouts.
- Alternate full-bleed cinematic data backdrops with clean white/charcoal “mathematical notebook” spreads for concept explanation.
- Use asymmetric compositions: oversized formula or diagram on one side, concise insight panel on the other.
- Each section gets a signature layout: statistics = distribution panels, probability = branching trees, hypothesis testing = split decision arena, regression = plotted model stage, classification = boundary-map canvas, metrics = dashboard scorecards.
- Bleed rules: hero visuals may extend edge-to-edge; all equations, labels, legends, and key takeaways stay inside safe margins.
- Use premium editorial devices: numbered chapter tabs, thin rule lines, equation captions, margin notes, floating annotation cards.

## Animation Style
- Smooth cinematic cross-dissolve and slide/parallax transitions, 700–900ms, ease-in-out cubic.
- Equations enter in sequential “write-on” strokes; symbols highlight with soft glow as concepts are introduced.
- Charts build progressively: axes first, data points second, model line/decision boundary third, annotations last.
- Probability trees and flow diagrams animate as branching light paths, moving from left to right with subtle node pulses.
- Hypothesis testing visuals use threshold reveals: shaded rejection regions fade in, p-value marker drops onto the curve.
- Evaluation dashboards animate with gentle counter-up numbers, filling bars, ROC/PR curves tracing in real time.

## Visual Requirements
- Cinematic premium aesthetic: dark graphite, warm ivory, electric blue, statistical violet, and restrained gold accents.
- Use high-end mathematical diagrams: normal curves, scatterplots, residual plots, confusion matrices, ROC curves, probability trees, regression planes.
- Illustration style: elegant vector geometry with precise labels, glowing data points, thin technical linework, and editorial annotations.
- Photography style: abstract macro imagery of data centers, glass screens, notebooks, chalk dust, and analysts in moody cinematic lighting.
- Apply subtle paper grain on light slides and faint glassmorphism/noise overlays on dark analytical slides.
- Avoid generic clip art; every visual should feel like a premium science magazine meets Apple keynote data storytelling.

## Slide-by-Slide Structure

**Slide 1 — The Hidden Geometry of Data**
- Mood: Cinematic premium opening; intelligent, mysterious, elegant — like entering a dark observatory where numbers become constellations.
- Layout: Full-bleed hero composition with a deep-space/data-cloud background; centered title over a subtle 3D scatterplot constellation; small subtitle strip at bottom: “Statistics • Probability • Models • Decisions.”
- Visual: Abstract mathematical universe: glowing data points suspended in depth, faint regression lines, translucent probability curves, matrix grids, and annotation marks like an editorial science magazine cover.
- FX: Slow parallax drift through floating data points; title fades in with precise cinematic timing; tiny particles pulse softly as if data is “breathing.”
- Color: Midnight navy, graphite black, electric cyan, soft ivory, muted violet highlights, restrained gold accents for premium polish.
- Type: Large cinematic serif title, elegant and authoritative; small mono-spaced technical labels around the data field; clean sans-serif subtitle with wide tracking.

**Slide 2 — Data Science as a Decision Engine**
- Mood: Strategic, polished, executive-intellectual; the feeling of a luxury Bloomberg terminal meeting a mathematical field notebook.
- Layout: Editorial split-screen: left side contains a vertical “data-to-decision” pipeline; right side shows a refined example card: “Predicting customer churn from behavioral signals.”
- Visual: Pipeline diagram: Raw Data → Statistics → Probability → Model → Prediction → Evaluation → Action. Each stage represented by premium glassmorphism cards, connected by glowing data-flow lines; include miniature icons: table, distribution curve, hypothesis symbol, regression plane, classifier boundary, metric gauge.
- FX: Data-flow line animates sequentially from left to right; each pipeline node softly lights up; example card slides in with a subtle paper-layer reveal.
- Color: Warm off-white editorial background with charcoal text; cyan and royal blue for analytical flow; amber highlight on “Decision”; faint grid texture beneath.
- Type: Bold sans-serif section header top-left; compact explanatory captions in modern grotesk; mono labels for formulas and variables; generous whitespace with magazine-style alignment.

**Slide 3 — Statistics: Turning Noise into Signal**
- Mood: Clear, analytical, cinematic teaching moment; calm precision with a sense of discovery.
- Layout: Three-panel editorial composition: left panel “Center,” middle panel “Spread,” right panel “Shape”; each panel contains one elegant mathematical visualization and a micro-example.
- Visual: Left: dot plot with mean/median markers. Middle: bell curve with standard deviation bands. Right: skewed distribution with annotated outliers. Include a small real-world example ribbon: “Example: Daily app session duration.”
- FX: Dots appear one by one, then collapse into summary markers; bell curve draws smoothly from left to right; outliers glow briefly to show their influence.
- Color: Ivory background, charcoal labels, deep blue curves, teal data points, restrained crimson for outliers, soft gray gridlines.
- Type: Serif headline: “Statistics: Turning Noise into Signal”; panel titles in crisp uppercase sans-serif; formulas in elegant math styling: mean, median, variance, standard deviation; captions small but readable, editorial and precise.

**Slide 4 — The Shape of Uncertainty**
- Mood: Cinematic statistical wonder; calm, intelligent, premium, like discovering hidden order inside noisy reality.
- Layout: Full-bleed dark editorial canvas with a large luminous probability distribution curve sweeping across the center; left-side narrative caption block; small inset cards for mean, median, variance, and standard deviation.
- Visual: Elegant mathematical diagram of a normal distribution, shaded confidence regions, floating sample points, subtle gridlines, and a small real-world example: “customer delivery times” plotted as dots beneath the curve.
- FX: Distribution curve draws itself in glowing motion; sample points softly fall into place; variance band expands outward with a slow cinematic pulse.
- Color: Deep navy black background, soft ivory typography, electric cyan curve, amber highlights for mean/variance markers.
- Type: Large editorial serif title top-left; mathematical labels in refined mono font; explanation text in clean premium sans-serif with generous spacing.

**Slide 5 — Probability: The Language of Possibility**
- Mood: Sleek, atmospheric, and analytical; a premium visual essay on chance, likelihood, and decision-making.
- Layout: Split-screen composition: left side shows a cinematic probability tree; right side features a polished card-based example comparing conditional probabilities.
- Visual: Branching probability tree for “Will a user click?” with paths for device type, time of day, and previous engagement; includes Bayes-style conditional probability notation as elegant floating equations.
- FX: Tree branches grow outward one by one; probabilities count upward smoothly; selected path glows as the example resolves.
- Color: Charcoal graphite base, muted teal branches, champagne-gold probability values, warm white annotation lines.
- Type: Bold serif headline; probability formulas in precise mono; short editorial captions placed like magazine pull quotes.

**Slide 6 — Testing the Signal**
- Mood: Dramatic and investigative; like a cinematic courtroom where data evidence is weighed against uncertainty.
- Layout: Central hypothesis-testing diagram with two overlapping distributions; left margin contains “H₀ vs H₁” as oversized typographic anchors; bottom strip shows a compact 4-step testing workflow.
- Visual: Bell curves representing null and alternative hypotheses, rejection region highlighted, p-value tail illuminated, alpha threshold marked with a sharp vertical line; example: “Does a new onboarding flow increase activation?”
- FX: Null distribution fades in first, alternative curve slides over it; rejection region lights up; p-value tail glows and narrows; final decision stamp appears subtly.
- Color: Midnight blue, ivory, crimson red for rejection region, icy blue for null distribution, gold for decision threshold.
- Type: Monumental serif for H₀/H₁; compact sans-serif workflow labels; mathematical notation treated as premium editorial graphic elements.

**Slide 7 — Regression: Drawing the Line Through Reality**
- Mood: Confident, cinematic, and explanatory; turning scattered observations into a predictive story.
- Layout: Large scatterplot occupying two-thirds of the slide with a glowing regression line cutting diagonally through the data; right-side vertical editorial panel explains slope, intercept, residuals, and prediction.
- Visual: Premium mathematical diagram of simple linear regression using a real-world example: “predicting house price from square footage”; residual lines drawn from points to the fitted line; small equation card: ŷ = β₀ + β₁x.
- FX: Data points appear as soft particles; regression line sweeps across the chart; residuals animate downward as thin luminous threads; prediction point pulses gently.
- Color: Ink-black background, pearl gridlines, sapphire data points, warm gold regression line, soft red residual markers.
- Type: Editorial serif title at top; equation in elegant mono inside a translucent glass card; explanatory labels in crisp sans-serif with minimal wording.

**Slide 8 — The Trial of Evidence**
- Mood: Cinematic courtroom for data: rigorous, tense, elegant, intellectually dramatic.
- Layout: Split editorial composition; left side shows a large hypothesis-testing decision flow, right side holds a premium “case file” panel with H₀, H₁, α, p-value, and decision outcome.
- Visual: Mathematical diagram of null vs alternative hypothesis with overlapping normal curves; shaded rejection region glows subtly; example card: “Does a new landing page improve conversion rate?”
- FX: Animated curve drawing, rejection region softly illuminates, p-value marker drops onto the axis like a verdict stamp; final decision appears as a refined embossed label.
- Color: Deep navy background, ivory graph lines, muted gold highlights, crimson rejection-zone accent, soft cyan statistical markers.
- Type: Large cinematic serif title top-left; formulas in crisp monospace/math type; concise editorial annotations in clean sans-serif.

**Slide 9 — Regression: Drawing the Line Through Chaos**
- Mood: Premium analytical clarity; a city-at-night data landscape where patterns emerge from noise.
- Layout: Full-width scatterplot hero with a glowing regression line cutting diagonally across the slide; right-side vertical sidebar explains slope, intercept, residuals, and R².
- Visual: Example: predicting house price from square footage; dots appear as luminous particles, residuals shown as fine vertical threads connecting points to the fitted line; small inset equation: ŷ = β₀ + β₁x.
- FX: Data points fade in like constellations, regression line sweeps across with a light-trail, residual lines animate one by one, R² gauge fills smoothly.
- Color: Charcoal black, midnight blue, electric teal data points, warm gold regression line, soft gray residuals.
- Type: Oversized serif title anchored bottom-left; equation set in elegant math typography; sidebar labels in compact editorial sans with generous spacing.

**Slide 10 — Classification: Mapping the Decision Frontier**
- Mood: Futuristic atlas of choices; intelligent, precise, cinematic, slightly sci-fi.
- Layout: Large central 2D feature-space map with two colored classes separated by a glowing nonlinear boundary; bottom strip contains mini cards for logistic regression, decision trees, and k-NN.
- Visual: Example: classifying emails as spam vs not spam using “link count” and “sender reputation”; probability contour lines ripple behind the decision boundary; miniature confusion icons show true/false outcomes.
- FX: Class points scatter into place, boundary materializes as a luminous contour, probability heatmap softly pulses, model cards slide upward like premium app modules.
- Color: Obsidian background, emerald class A, amber class B, violet probability gradient, white contour lines, subtle red for misclassified points.
- Type: Bold editorial title at top center; axis labels in refined monospace; model-card headings in condensed sans; tiny explanatory captions in warm ivory.

**Slide 11 — The Scoreboard of Truth**
- Mood: High-stakes performance dashboard; polished, exact, investor-grade yet cinematic.
- Layout: Premium metrics dashboard on a dark editorial canvas; left side shows a large confusion matrix, right side stacks metric tiles: accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC.
- Visual: Confusion matrix rendered as glassmorphic heatmap blocks; ROC curve floats beneath as a glowing arc; example annotation: “Medical screening model: prioritize recall when false negatives are costly.”
- FX: Matrix cells count upward, metric tiles illuminate sequentially, ROC curve draws with a neon pen stroke, threshold slider moves to show precision-recall tradeoff.
- Color: Graphite, deep blue, icy white typography, cyan metric highlights, gold for optimal threshold, red-orange for error cells.
- Type: Magazine-style serif headline upper-left; metric values in large numerical sans; formulas in small monospace beneath each tile; key insight callout in elegant italic serif.

**Slide 12 — The Confusion Matrix: Where Predictions Meet Reality**
- Mood: cinematic analyst war-room; precise, intelligent, high-stakes, like decoding a model’s truth under glass.
- Layout: full-screen 2×2 confusion matrix centered like a glowing command table; left margin contains a vertical “Actual” axis, top edge contains “Predicted”; right side has a slim editorial annotation column explaining TP, FP, FN, TN with tiny real-world examples.
- Visual: premium mathematical diagram with four luminous cells: True Positive, False Positive, False Negative, True Negative; each cell includes a miniature icon-based example such as fraud detected, healthy transaction flagged, missed fraud, normal transaction cleared.
- FX: cells animate one-by-one with soft light pulses; prediction arrows glide across the grid; incorrect cells briefly glow amber-red before settling; subtle parallax depth behind the matrix.
- Color: deep graphite background, ivory grid lines, electric cyan for correct classifications, ember red for errors, soft gold annotation highlights.
- Type: large cinematic serif title top-left; matrix labels in crisp geometric sans; formulas and abbreviations in refined mono with editorial callout lines.

**Slide 13 — Precision, Recall & F1: The Balance of Consequences**
- Mood: elegant decision science; dramatic but controlled, showing that every metric carries a cost.
- Layout: split editorial composition: left side features three oversized metric cards stacked vertically; right side shows a cinematic seesaw diagram balancing “False Positives” and “False Negatives.”
- Visual: mathematical formula cards for Precision = TP / TP + FP, Recall = TP / TP + FN, F1 = 2PR / P + R; below each formula, include a simple applied example: medical screening, spam detection, fraud monitoring.
- FX: numerator and denominator terms highlight sequentially; seesaw gently tilts as FP/FN weights appear; F1 card forms from two crossing light arcs merging into a central harmonic-balance symbol.
- Color: midnight navy base, porcelain white cards, cyan for precision, violet for recall, gold for F1, muted red for error-cost indicators.
- Type: editorial serif for slide title; formulas in clean mathematical typesetting; example labels in small caps sans with generous tracking.

**Slide 14 — ROC & AUC: Reading the Curve of Confidence**
- Mood: cinematic observatory of model performance; sleek, futuristic, quietly impressive.
- Layout: large ROC curve chart dominates the slide, floating over a dark gradient background; bottom strip contains threshold snapshots as tiny cinematic frames; upper-right has a premium KPI badge: “AUC = 0.91.”
- Visual: glowing ROC curve rising above a faint diagonal baseline labeled “Random Guess”; axes labeled True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate; threshold markers appear as small luminous nodes across the curve.
- FX: diagonal baseline draws first in muted gray; ROC curve traces itself with a neon light trail; threshold nodes appear with soft ticks; AUC area fills with transparent blue-gold gradient.
- Color: obsidian-to-deep-blue gradient, silver axis lines, electric blue ROC curve, warm gold AUC fill, restrained white text.
- Type: title set large across top-left; axis labels in refined mono; AUC badge uses bold modern sans with small editorial caption beneath: “Higher area = stronger separability.”

**Slide 15 — The Data Science Compass: From Question to Decision**
- Mood: grand cinematic finale; premium, strategic, inspiring, like the closing frame of an Apple keynote for analytical thinking.
- Layout: circular compass diagram centered, surrounded by six orbiting fundamentals: Statistics, Probability, Hypothesis Testing, Regression, Classification, Evaluation; bottom contains one powerful closing statement in magazine-style typography.
- Visual: elegant radial system map where each concept appears as a glowing node connected by fine mathematical lines; subtle equations, scatterplots, bell curves, decision boundaries, and metric icons embedded as ghosted background details.
- FX: nodes illuminate clockwise as the story completes; connecting lines draw like constellations; final center word “Decision” glows softly; background equations drift almost imperceptibly.
- Color: rich charcoal canvas, warm ivory typography, cyan analytical lines, gold decision node, restrained violet shadows for depth.
- Type: cinematic serif title at top; compass labels in premium sans; closing statement large and centered near bottom: “Data science is the craft of turning uncertainty into action.”
